syntax = "proto3";
package demo.v1;
option go_package = "example.com/demo/v1;demov1";
import "google/protobuf/timestamp.proto";

enum Dir { DIR_UNSPECIFIED = 0; DIR_NORTH = 1; reserved 5, 7 to 9; }

message Robot {
  string name = 1;
  repeated int32 pos = 2 [packed = true];
  map<string, Dir> dirs = 3;
  oneof kind { bool simple = 4; Robot nested = 5; }
  google.protobuf.Timestamp at = 6;
  reserved "old";
}

service RobotService { rpc Move(Robot) returns (stream Robot); }
